data.name: SCAN read: STALE (COMMITTING_GD / RECONCILING_GD, lease expired > 10 min), DEAD_PRE (pre-commit dead leases), GAP (a job not post-commit whose gd_id is a Created delivery, or any live delivery of a FAILED / CANCELLED job, by primary key), TERM_OP (FAILED / CANCELLED jobs with a non-rejected inventory operation), REVIEW count - at most 200 each

script.code:
SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'STALE' AS kind, CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(j.lease_owner AS CHAR) AS k, CAST(j.job_status AS CHAR) AS v, CAST(j.attempt_count AS CHAR) AS n, DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS x,
       CAST(COALESCE((SELECT g.gd_status FROM goods_delivery g WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1IHEEHSE.data.tenantId}}' AND g.id = CAST(j.gd_id AS UNSIGNED) AND g.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1), '') AS CHAR) AS y, '0' AS deleted
  FROM gd_async_job j
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1IHEEHSE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.is_deleted = 0
   AND j.job_status IN ('COMMITTING_GD', 'RECONCILING_GD')
   AND j.lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL
   AND j.lease_expires_at < n.t - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE
 ORDER BY j.lease_expires_at
 LIMIT 200) a
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'DEAD_PRE' AS kind, CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(j.lease_owner AS CHAR) AS k, CAST(j.job_status AS CHAR) AS v, CAST(j.attempt_count AS CHAR) AS n, DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS x, '' AS y, '0' AS deleted
  FROM gd_async_job j
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1IHEEHSE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.is_deleted = 0
   AND j.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'CALCULATING', 'AWAITING_CONFIRMATION', 'READY_TO_COMMIT')
   AND j.lease_owner IS NOT NULL
   AND j.lease_owner <> ''
   AND j.lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL
   AND j.lease_expires_at <= n.t
 ORDER BY j.lease_expires_at
 LIMIT 200) b
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'GAP' AS kind, CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS k, CAST(j.job_status AS CHAR) AS v, CAST(g.gd_status AS CHAR) AS n,
       CAST(COALESCE((SELECT o.dispatch_status FROM gd_outbox o WHERE o.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1IHEEHSE.data.tenantId}}' AND o.job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) AND o.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1), '') AS CHAR) AS x, CAST(g.delivery_no AS CHAR) AS y, '0' AS deleted
  FROM gd_async_job j
  JOIN goods_delivery g
    ON g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1IHEEHSE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.id = CAST(j.gd_id AS UNSIGNED)
   AND g.is_deleted = 0
   AND (g.gd_status = 'Created' OR j.job_status IN ('FAILED', 'CANCELLED'))
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1IHEEHSE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.is_deleted = 0
   AND j.job_status NOT IN ('GD_COMMITTED', 'CREATING_PICKING', 'PICKING_RETRYING', 'PICKING_READY', 'COMPLETED')
   AND j.gd_id IS NOT NULL
   AND j.gd_id <> ''
 ORDER BY j.id
 LIMIT 200) c
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'TERM_OP' AS kind, CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(op.operation_id AS CHAR) AS k, CAST(j.job_status AS CHAR) AS v, '' AS n, CAST(op.operation_status AS CHAR) AS x,
       CAST(COALESCE((SELECT g.gd_status FROM goods_delivery g WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1IHEEHSE.data.tenantId}}' AND g.id = CAST(j.gd_id AS UNSIGNED) AND g.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1), '') AS CHAR) AS y, '0' AS deleted
  FROM inventory_operation op
  JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1IHEEHSE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = CAST(op.source_job_id AS UNSIGNED)
   AND j.organization_id = op.organization_id
   AND j.is_deleted = 0
   AND j.job_status IN ('FAILED', 'CANCELLED')
 WHERE op.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1IHEEHSE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND op.is_deleted = 0
   AND op.operation_status <> 'REJECTED'
   AND op.source_job_id <> ''
 ORDER BY op.id
 LIMIT 200) d
UNION ALL
SELECT 'REVIEW' AS kind, '' AS id, '' AS k, '' AS v, CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR) AS n, '' AS x, '' AS y, '0' AS deleted
  FROM gd_async_job j
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1IHEEHSE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.is_deleted = 0
   AND j.job_status = 'REQUIRES_REVIEW'

script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(n.t + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_until,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.organization_id,
       j.plant_id,
       j.job_status,
       j.progress_percent,
       j.progress_message,
       j.attempt_count,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at,
       j.lease_owner,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       (j.lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND j.lease_expires_at < n.t - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AS past_grace,
       j.row_version,
       j.error_code,
       j.error_message,
       j.error_details,
       CAST(j.gd_id AS CHAR) AS gd_id,
       j.gd_no,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.gd_committed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS gd_committed_at,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.finished_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS finished_at,
       j.is_deleted,
       CAST(cr.id AS CHAR) AS rclaim_id,
       DATE_FORMAT(cr.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS rclaim_started_at,
       cr.result_ref AS rclaim_owner,
       (cr.id IS NOT NULL AND cr.started_at > n.t - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AS rclaim_live,
       CAST(cw.id AS CHAR) AS claim_id,
       cw.result_ref AS claim_owner,
       (cw.id IS NOT NULL AND cw.started_at > n.t - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AS claim_live
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1IHEEHSE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_1IHEEHSE.data.jobId}}
  LEFT JOIN gd_publish_step cr
    ON cr.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1IHEEHSE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND cr.job_id = '{{node:code_node_1IHEEHSE.data.jobId}}'
   AND cr.step_name = (CONCAT('R0_CLAIM_', j.row_version) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
   AND cr.is_deleted = 0
  LEFT JOIN gd_publish_step cw
    ON cw.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1IHEEHSE.data.tenantId}}'
   AND cw.job_id = '{{node:code_node_1IHEEHSE.data.jobId}}'
   AND cw.step_name = (CONCAT('W0_CLAIM_', j.row_version) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
   AND cw.is_deleted = 0
